publication_rule: Only records with publish_ready=true should appear in the public event directory.
active_event_rule: status in [upcoming, recurring] and either end_datetime is in the future, or end_datetime is null and the local event date has not passed
expiration_rule: Events with a known end_datetime expire after that time. Events with an unknown end_datetime require review after the local event date and are then moved to ended/archive.

schema_notes.end_datetime_policy: end_datetime may be null when the organizer has not published an ending time. Such records require manual review after the event date and must not be assigned an invented ending time.
schema_notes.source_integrity_rule: Do not infer a street address, ending time, ticket link, or organizer URL that was not supported by the supplied source.

events.description: Greg Guymon's Margaritaville-themed birthday bash at Calhoun's 2.0 in Denison. Doors open at 7:00 PM. Admission is $10 for guests age 21 and older and $20 for guests ages 18–20. The kitchen is open until 11:00 PM.
events.verification_note: Entered from the Texoma Weekend Roundup supplied by Eugene Clark. Doors open at 7:00 PM; the event ending time and exact street address were not stated. The venue_slug was verified against the Business Directory.

events.verification_note: Entered from the Texoma Weekend Roundup. Doors open at 7:00 PM. The event ending time was not published. Cover pricing and kitchen hours were supplied by the venue post.

events.event_name: Standup Comedy — Erica Lederman: One Night Only
events.description: Trace Time Productions brings Erica Lederman, a Florida’s Funniest Comedian finalist, to The Milieu Wine Bar for a one-night standup comedy event. Erica is known for sharp, honest comedy and fearless energy. Trace Rossi hosts the show. Doors open at 7:00 PM, and the performance begins at 8:00 PM. Seating is limited.
events.verification_note: Verified from the official Facebook Event jointly published by Trace Time Productions and The Milieu Wine Bar, along with the official event flyer. Doors open at 7:00 PM, the show starts at 8:00 PM, admission is $10 at the door, and a two-item minimum applies. No event end time or age restriction was published.

events.description: Highest Blessings presents a Metaphysical & Holistic Fair at Midway Mall in Sherman. The fair will be held in Center Court just inside the mall’s main entrance and will feature spiritual treasures, intuitive readers, healing arts, crystals, spiritual tools, local artisans, and other metaphysical and holistic vendors.
events.verification_note: Verified through the official Facebook Event hosted by Highest Blessings and Deborah Renee, the official event description, and the promotional flyer. The event is Sunday, July 26, 2026, from 11:00 AM to 5:00 PM at Midway Mall in Sherman. Organizers state that vendors will be located in Center Court just inside the mall’s main entrance. No admission price or age restriction was published in the supplied sources.

events.event_name: Denison Fire vs. Durant Fire Hot Dog Eating Contest
events.description: The Battle is On! The Denison Fire Department takes on the Durant Fire Department in an epic hot dog eating contest on The Point Restaurant Patio. Guests can cheer for their favorite department, grab lunch, and support two outstanding fire departments during this family-friendly community event. The contest will also be streamed live on the KLBC Facebook page for those unable to attend in person.
events.verification_note: Verified from The Point Restaurant's official Facebook post and event flyer. The event takes place Saturday, July 25, 2026, from 11:00 AM to 1:00 PM on The Point Restaurant Patio. The contest features the Denison Fire Department versus the Durant Fire Department and will be livestreamed on the KLBC Facebook page. No admission fee, registration requirement, or age restriction was published.
